ns2:section.sectionText: This is an on-line section. This class section has regularly-scheduled class meetings. Because learning to write is a lot like learning to play an instrument or a sport, in-class participation (in BTW 250) is an essential part of becoming a more successful writer; taking the class online does not change that.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
